verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de claims 'B2B bulk notarization and API integration' in its llms.txt, and its translation endpoint accepts 'one or multiple documents' in a single request. These are the product's own multi-item capabilities, but the evidence is thin, and the notarization, incorporation and registration endpoints all appear to work on one item at a time. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint or bulk-submission workflow, details on bulk notarization mechanics (limits, status tracking across items), bulk operations beyond translation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
